metadata.title: सिरिंगसिया विद्रोह और हो आदिवासियों का बलिदान | The tribal revolt of Sarengsia | Tribal History
metadata.description: The Ho tribe of the Kolhan region of Jharkhand have a rich history of the freedom movement. This tribe fought to save their land not only from the Britishers but also from local Rajas. In 1821 when a local raja named Jagannath with help of Britishers tried to control this region, there was a violent backlash from tribals. The tribal attacked the British army in the valley of Sarensia and killed many soldiers of the enemy. Later the leaders of this uprising were caught and hanged. But this uprising paved the way for the Kol revolt of 1831.
